items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: my first attempt actually was with Malcolm Janay. We just had a duet there for about two or three years during high school. And then the banjo bums was organized in 1955.

ctx.x: When did you start playing with bands?

Well, I think the first attempt was the banjo bums, which was, well, my first attempt actually was with Malcolm Janay. We just had a duet there for about two or three years during high school. And then the banjo bums was organized in 1955. And the recording was made in 1956.
And who was in it, who was in the banjo bums other than you and Janay?
